name: Notional V1 Escrow uint128 truncation in free-collateral ETH conversion
summary: Notional V1 Escrow's ETH conversion cast abs(balance) to uint128 unchecked, so a -2^128 balance counted as 0 ETH. Via public ERC1155Trade fCash pair mints the attacker made one account owe 2^128 DAI fCash while passing free collateral, used the unbacked receiver leg to mint matured DAI/USDC claims, then settled and withdrew them.
notes: The truncating conversion is inlined in the Escrow implementation installed in 0xd94e36ee; its second Upgraded event (block 25901449) is the post-incident fix. Portfolios and ERC1155Trade were upgraded within minutes of it in December 2020 and only carried the calls.

The anchor minted the unbacked fCash and moved no ERC-20; the campaign transaction settled and withdrew. Loss is the escrow's entire DAI and USDC; its WETH and WBTC were not taken, and a third-party liquidation at block 25900571 is excluded.
